one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-30. I accept the supervisor's finding that Q3 results are most likely ~Nov 5 (no 8-K or company date; Q3 reported Nov 2-7 every year 2021-2025; MarketBeat Nov 5 estimated) [32], so I put only ~10% on an in-window print and no longer widen for earnings. The China export-control truce now runs to 10 Jan 2027 [31], outside the window. In-window flow is headlines: China's Golden Week (Oct 1-7) halts SMM trading with Pr-Nd firm at 738-741k yuan/t into the holiday and a 'firm if post-holiday restocking holds' outlook [26]; September customs data (due ~Oct 20) on magnet exports after August's 21% drop to the US [28,29]; possible GM shipment news. None is a strong directional edge, and 23% short interest [34] makes squeezes and drops both possible. The stock fell ~21% in September then bounced 5.8% on Sep 30, so there is no clean momentum or reversal signal. Near-symmetric lognormal: median ~$47.1, monthly sigma ~0.20 (74%/3.5, not widened).

fair_value.method: Blend on ~239M FD shares with converts as equity and ~$0.95B net cash and claims at Sep-2027: EV/EBITDA 2028E $460M x 19x = $40.5 (50%), sum of the parts = $40.6 (30%), EV/sales 2027E $680M x 12x = $38.1 (20%). Blended $40.0, below spot; the gap to $47 is the scarcity and policy option, which I put in the ladder's right tail rather than in fair value.

base.story: Execution roughly on plan: >1,000t/qtr NdPr, GM commercial magnets from Q4 2026, Dy/Tb started; the floor keeps PPA income flowing; the truce is extended piecemeal; the multiple drifts slightly lower as Western competitors (E-VAC, Noveon, USA Rare Earth) win defense orders.

bull.story: The January cliff lapses or controls re-tighten (US magnet imports from China were already down 21% in August), NdPr goes back above the $110 floor, and new defense or OEM offtakes land; 23% short interest fuels a re-rating toward the $100 52-week high.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$30 (the DoW's $30.03 preferred/warrant price) the ~239M-share equity is ~$7.2B, about the floor-protected Materials value plus the 10X guarantee NPV and net cash, with almost nothing for Independence magnets or the scarcity option. reasoning: Round 2. I accepted the supervisor's evidence-backed corrections: FD shares ~239M with the 2030 converts as equity (34.4M at $21.74, with a capped call to $31.06), the warrant and capped-call value added back; 2027 consensus EBITDA now $377.7M and 2028 $540M; the truce cliff on 10 Jan 2027; Q3 results ~Nov 5, not Oct 29; the $45.5M deferred prepayment is GM's, not Apple's. Fixing the share count alone cuts my round-1 EV/EBITDA value from $43.4 to ~$41. I also cut 2028E EBITDA to $460M (a 45% Materials margin was too generous given Q2's ~29%), raised the multiple to 19x to match the corrected current EV, replaced 40% EV/sales with a 30% SOTP plus 20% EV/sales, and got a blended fair value of $40.0. I disagree slightly with the supervisor's $44: my 2028E is near the low end of its $430-500M band, and I give less credit for a premium multiple because procurement data show competitors winning DLA magnet orders [30]. Following the source review, I replaced newsletter recaps with primary alternative data: SMM weekly Pr-Nd 738-741k yuan/t firm into Golden Week [26,27]; Chinese customs data showing magnet exports down 18% YoY in August and to the US down 21% MoM [28,29], which supports the scarcity story; and DoD contract notices [30]. Job postings (~90-100 Fort Worth roles) [14,15] still point to an active build-out. Distribution: lognormal with median ~$46 (pulled about a quarter of the way from spot toward fair value, because the policy option is real and the January cliff fattens the right tail), sigma ~0.62, upper tail nudged up slightly for the cliff and 23% short interest. Scenario mean ~$51 (bear $26/27%, base $46/48%, bull $90/25%) roughly matches the ladder's skew. Research was capped at ~6 follow-up queries; X/Reddit were not used.
